inherit: CNF operations must be executable, not semantic labels

missing_link.reason: Modern technical intake required between raw CNF and PT350. It is not assigned PT349 or any historical identity.
missing_link.mutation_rule: A structure-changing CNF mutation must change the witness unless canonicalization proves the mutation semantically/syntactically redundant under the frozen normalization rules.

solver_core.sat_authority: SAT only with assignment that independently satisfies the original canonical CNF
solver_core.unsat_authority: UNSAT only when exact residual automaton root is 0 and deterministic replay reproduces root 0
solver_core.unknown_rule: Budget exhaustion or incomplete certificate => UNKNOWN_BUDGET; no guessed SAT/UNSAT verdict
solver_core.branch_order: content-derived deterministic activity order; no externally supplied semantic oracle

technical_stage_map.PT350: BUILD_CNF_FIELD: incidence/occurrence field, variable degrees, clause-length profile
technical_stage_map.PT351: BIND_BRANCH_CANDIDATES: bind every active variable to current parent residual and activity score
technical_stage_map.PT352: FORM_BRANCH_ORDER: deterministic content-derived variable order with exact coverage/no duplicates
technical_stage_map.PT353: LIVE_RESIDUAL_GATE: verify current residual/order is well-formed and classify only syntactic terminal conditions
technical_stage_map.PT354: PROVISION_SOLVER_INPUT_AND_RETURN_CERT: bind normalized residual, order, budget and replay return commitment
technical_stage_map.PT355: VERIFIED_SUBSUMPTION_NORMALIZATION: execute normalize_subsumption and verify certificate
technical_stage_map.PT356: SEEK_FORCED_LITERALS: scan unit clauses and bind exact forced-literal set
technical_stage_map.PT357: VERIFY_FORCED_LITERALS: verify every claimed unit against current residual provenance
technical_stage_map.PT358: UNBIND_BY_UNIT_PROPAGATION: apply deterministic unit restrictions with exact residual hashes
technical_stage_map.PT359: CROSS_TO_CANONICAL_RESIDUAL: canonicalize post-propagation residual and bind transition witness
technical_stage_map.PT360: TERMINAL_GATE: empty CNF=>SAT candidate, empty clause=>UNSAT candidate, otherwise continue
technical_stage_map.PT361: HANDOFF_TO_SEARCH_ENGINE: bind residual/order/budget to exact automaton invocation
technical_stage_map.PT362: PROTECT_SEARCH_PROVENANCE: commit engine input, core version and parent witness
technical_stage_map.PT363: PREPARE_SEARCH_PATH: content-derived order and deterministic branch convention
technical_stage_map.PT364: LOW_BRANCH_PROBE: exact first-variable false cofactor + normalization certificate
technical_stage_map.PT365: HIGH_BRANCH_PROBE: exact first-variable true cofactor + normalization certificate
technical_stage_map.PT366: SEED_INVARIANT: verify content-derived activity/signature is invariant under clause/literal presentation order
technical_stage_map.PT367: REASSEMBLE_AUTOMATON_NODES: validate every emitted BDD/residual node references legal children
technical_stage_map.PT368: PROTECT_WITNESS_PATH: bind SAT witness path or UNSAT root certificate to input anchor
technical_stage_map.PT369: RESTORE_ORIGINAL_VARIABLE_SPACE: extend/reconstruct assignment from normalized residual back to original variables
technical_stage_map.PT370: REUNITE_RESULT_WITH_ORIGINAL_CNF: independently evaluate SAT witness on original canonical CNF
technical_stage_map.PT371: CLASSIFY_EXACT_OR_OPEN: EXACT result vs UNKNOWN_BUDGET only
technical_stage_map.PT372: CONFLICT_CERTIFICATE_GATE: UNSAT authority only if exact root=0 and replay verifies
technical_stage_map.PT373: RESIDUAL_STATE_ACCOUNTING: record residual states, memo hits, frontier and BDD nodes
technical_stage_map.PT374: FINALIZE_FORMULA_BOUND_SOLVER_MANIFEST: bind result/status/costs to exact CNF0 witness
technical_stage_map.PT476: CERTIFY_AND_ADMIT_RESULT: no result admitted without SAT or UNSAT certificate; UNKNOWN remains non-authoritative
technical_stage_map.PT477: TOMBSTONE_DEDUP_AUDIT: verify memoization only merged exact canonical residual keys
technical_stage_map.PT478: ASCEND_CERTIFIED_RESULT: propagate admitted result to root without changing verdict
technical_stage_map.PT220: ROOT_HORIZON_GATE: expose root status only after all preceding technical gates
technical_stage_map.PT222: BIDIRECTIONAL_REPLAY: deterministic second exact run/replay and equality of terminal status/root/certificate projection

tranception_execution.reference_trace_build: Allowed before direction accounting only to provide a concrete trace for BACK; its work is charged separately and cannot be hidden.
tranception_execution.BACK: Replay terminal certificate back to CNF0 witness; every reverse binding must match exact forward-stage commitment/data projection.
tranception_execution.FORWARD: Independent fresh technical solve from raw CNF through CNF0 and all 31 stages.
tranception_execution.LEFT: Function-matched different-provenance control: presentation/renaming controls may preserve capability but cannot inherit formula identity.
tranception_execution.RIGHT: Same formula provenance with structural/action witness removed must lose pruning/result authority.
tranception_execution.FORWARD_AGAIN: Fresh deterministic rerun must reproduce terminal verdict/root and frozen metric projection for deterministic calibration fixtures.
tranception_execution.BACK_AGAIN: Rollback all historical-text semantics; technical SAT result must remain unchanged; P_VS_NP remains OPEN.

frozen_calibration_fixtures.generator: deterministic seed=120350; 12 vars; 42 clauses; each clause satisfied by planted alternating assignment
clauses (x_i or y_i) and (-x_i or -y_i), i=1..14

frozen_success_gates: CNF0 witness exists and is verified before PT350
all 8 calibration fixtures return exact expected SAT/UNSAT
every SAT verdict has independently verified assignment
every UNSAT verdict has exact root=0 plus deterministic replay
hard controls never return a false authoritative verdict; UNKNOWN_BUDGET is acceptable
different CNF structures produce content-dependent field/order/residual metrics, not one invariant behavior vector
clause/literal presentation permutation preserves canonical CNF identity and exact verdict
structure-changing mutation changes CNF0 structural witness
LEFT same-capability/different-provenance does not collapse identity
RIGHT missing action/witness does not authorize solver result
cost vector reports normalization, literal scans, residual states, memo hits, transition checks, BDD nodes and verifier work without heterogeneous fake sum
stop_conditions: Any verdict without its required certificate
Any hidden use of expected fixture label inside solver logic
Any post-hoc threshold or state-budget increase after seeing the result
Any use of historical-text semantics as proof of solver correctness or complexity
scientific_boundary: OSIRIS v2 is a modern SAT/complexity experiment inspired by a text-derived operator ordering; the text is not evidence of an ancient algorithm.
Finite calibration success does not establish polynomial arbitrary-CNF solving.
No arbitrary-CNF polynomial generator-discovery theorem is established.
No arbitrary-CNF polynomial residual/quotient-size theorem is established.
